cards.title: When another exchange is useful
items: Missing grounds, a counterexample, or an alternative must affect the choice and need reviewer input.
After host clarification, return to step 2. Reuse authorized material within the agreed scope and budget.

cards.title: When to stop
items: Return supported results and remaining disagreement; there is no fixed round or finding quota.
A viable original can still have a worthwhile alternative. Style preferences or repeated positions are insufficient.
